name: Chimaera
description:
Chimaera is a bow which splits into a wood and stone sword when swung. Sneak-right-click while holding both to reform the bow. Each applies a mark which the other can redeem to grant a 40% speed burst and apply bonus effects:
- Serpent's Fang🏹 redeems 2 seconds of venom.
- Lion's Claw⚔️ redeems 2x damage.
- Goat's Horn⚔️ redeems 2x knockback and a 1-second stun.

Venom: a rapid poison which heals you for 50% of the damage dealt.
Stun: halts an entity, preventing movement, attacks, and shots. Direct strikes break enemies out of stuns.
